player_outfit.description: Off-duty worn black crewneck and dark trousers. Personal romance scenes never inherit the current job uniform.

t0.heroine_outfit: Muted coral-rose wrap swim dress with an open pale sky-blue cover-up.
t0.eye_line: Daeun looks just off-axis toward Minjun at camera-left; her head, shoulders, and smile follow the same line.

t0.heroine_outfit: Deep emerald asymmetric high-neck swim dress with an open smoke-gray cover-up and restrained silver jewelry.
t0.eye_line: Jiyeon looks down-left directly toward the visible Minjun; Minjun looks up-right at her.
Daeun watches the fireworks while Minjun watches her.

t0.heroine_outfit: Unbranded deep-charcoal hooded windbreaker over black.
t0.eye_line: Jiyeon turns back toward Minjun after taking his hand.

t0.heroine_outfit: Muted pale-blue belted shirt dress with a beige cardigan.
t0.eye_line: Daeun looks up toward the blossom canopy.

t0.heroine_outfit: Warm-cream tailored spring jacket over a black fine-knit top.
t0.eye_line: Jiyeon looks back toward Minjun over her shoulder.

t0.heroine_outfit: Muted cranberry quilted winter coat over charcoal layers with an oatmeal knit scarf and dark trousers.
t0.player_outfit: Worn black quilted winter jacket over a charcoal crewneck and dark trousers.
t0.eye_line: Daeun and Minjun hold mutual eye contact while she offers exactly one of two small canned coffees.

t0.heroine_outfit: Deep charcoal tailored cashmere coat over a dark garnet turtleneck with black trousers and restrained geometric earrings.
t0.player_outfit: Worn black quilted winter jacket over a charcoal crewneck and dark trousers.
t0.eye_line: Jiyeon turns from the left-hand-drive driver's seat and holds mutual eye contact with Minjun in the front passenger seat after asking him to stay.

t0.heroine_outfit: Navy work polo with a beige knit cardigan.
t0.eye_line: Daeun and Minjun hold mutual eye contact.
t0.prelude_outfit: The same navy work polo and beige knit cardigan before the CG reveal.

t0.heroine_outfit: Cream tailored jacket over black with restrained gold jewelry.
t0.eye_line: Jiyeon and Minjun hold mutual eye contact.
t0.prelude_outfit: The same cream tailored jacket and black inner before the CG reveal.

t1.heroine_outfit: Deep muted oxblood fine-knit top and charcoal trousers, coat removed, nearly bare face.
t1.eye_line: Jiyeon and Minjun hold mutual eye contact across the narrow floor aisle; neither looks at the lens.
t1.prelude_outfit: Travel-creased charcoal long coat worn open over the same oxblood fine-knit top.

t1.heroine_outfit: Muted moss-green short duffle coat over an ivory ribbed knit and dark straight jeans.
t1.eye_line: Daeun and Minjun hold mutual eye contact; her head, pupils, shoulders, and relaxed hand on the rail above the existing locks all support the exchange.
t1.prelude_outfit: Muted moss-green short duffle coat over an ivory ribbed knit and dark straight jeans.

t1.heroine_outfit: Deep sapphire-blue tailored belted wool coat over a charcoal-black silk mock-neck and slim black trousers.
t1.eye_line: Jiyeon studies an existing padlock while Minjun watches her; her lowered pupils, chin, crossed arms, and planted feet share the same target.
t1.prelude_outfit: Deep sapphire-blue tailored belted wool coat over a charcoal-black silk mock-neck and slim black trousers.

t1.heroine_outfit: Muted slate-blue cotton chore jacket over an ivory crewneck knit, dark straight jeans, and a charcoal canvas crossbody strap.
t1.eye_line: Daeun and Minjun both look down toward the lost child; the child looks directly up at Daeun. Their joined hands remain centered and anatomically separate.

t1.heroine_outfit: Deep wine-red tailored suede cropped jacket over a charcoal-black silk mock-neck and fitted black trousers.
t1.eye_line: Four-frame sequence: both address the booth lens, then share mutual eye contact, laugh together, and end with Jiyeon kissing Minjun's cheek while his surprise remains natural.

t1.heroine_outfit: Pale sage lightweight cotton overshirt with rolled sleeves over an ivory T-shirt, dark navy trousers, and a charcoal shoulder strap.
t1.eye_line: Daeun sleeps with her head resting against the bus window while Minjun watches her and the shared rural-to-Seoul reflection with a quiet, relieved expression.
t1.prelude_outfit: The same pale sage overshirt, ivory T-shirt, navy trousers, and charcoal shoulder strap used through the two-day summer trip.

t1.heroine_outfit: Muted dusty-mauve soft-knit wrap cardigan over a cream square-neck cotton top with charcoal lounge trousers; the same indoor outfit continues into the first morning.
t1.eye_line: Daeun looks down at the rolled omelet in the pan; her profile, shoulders, spatula hand, and pan hand all support the cooking action without lens contact.

t1.heroine_outfit: Deep midnight-blue matte-silk wrap lounge blouse with muted burgundy piping and black tailored lounge trousers; the same indoor outfit continues into the first morning.
t1.eye_line: Bare-faced Jiyeon looks directly at Minjun at the player camera while one hand pulls the duvet to her nose; the other hand remains hidden.

t1.heroine_outfit: Deep muted berry-red fine-knit date dress with a modest square neckline under a soft charcoal cropped cardigan.
t1.eye_line: Daeun looks through restrained tears at Minjun across the table; her hand-over-mouth reaction and the open ring box share one readable upper-safe triangle.

t2.heroine_outfit: Muted dusty-mauve wrap cardigan over a cream home top with charcoal lounge trousers; short hair and left-temple clip remain canonical.
t2.eye_line: Daeun looks just past Minjun without lens contact while her right hand presses one red seal and her left hand steadies the blank separation paper; Minjun faces her from the rear foreground without reaching.

t2.heroine_outfit: Ivory tailored blazer over a black blouse and black trousers with geometric earrings, structured black handbag, and canonical waist-length waves.
t2.eye_line: Jiyeon looks into the cool apartment corridor and crosses the threshold without turning to the lens; Minjun remains seated behind her and watches without reaching.
